title: How to Upgrade From Windows 10 to Windows 11 For Free - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Upgrading from Windows 10 to Windows 11 is free for eligible devices. The best part about this is that you don't need to spend any additional charges on a new PC, you can upgrade to Windows 11 for free. Whether you want to enhance gaming performance, an advanced user interface, or better security, Windows 11 is the better choice over Windows 10.

1. Pre-Upgrade: Check System Compatibility

Before starting the upgrade, it's essential to make a quick cross-check to determine whether your Windows 10 PC is eligible or not for upgrading to Windows 11. Your system must meet the following requirements to upgrade to Windows 11.

  • Processor: 1 GHz or faster with 2 cores.
  • RAM: Minimum 4 GB.
  • Storage: Minimum 64 GB of storage.
  • Firmware: Should support Secure Boot.
  • Graphics Card: DirectX 12 compatible.
  • Display: A display greater than 9 inches with HD Resolution (720p)
  • Internet: Required for updates and certain features.
  • Microsoft Account: Needed for setup and some features.

Note: You can use the PC Health Check tool to verify if your current Windows 10 PC is eligible or not to upgrade to win 11.

2. Methods to Upgrade From Windows 10 to Windows 11 For Free

There are several methods to upgrade from Windows 10 to Windows 11, and Microsoft has made it easy to download and install the new operating system. Below is the list of the following methods to perform the Win 11 upgradation:

  • Method 1: Windows 11 Installer Assistant
  • Method 2: Create Windows 11 Installation Media
  • Method 3: Windows 11 ISO Download

2.1. Method 1: Use Windows 11 Installer Assistant

Windows 11 Installation Assistant is one of the most useful tools to download & install Windows 11 for Free. If you want to use this tool, follow these steps:

Step 1: Visit the Official Microsoft Windows Website

Go to Microsoft's Download Windows 11 page. There you will see an option named Windows 11 Installation Assistant.

Step 2: Start the downloading process

Click on the Download Now button located underneath Before you begin to start downloading the tool.

Step 3: Run the Downloaded File and Accept the Terms & License

After downloading, run the file. Now, it will ask for your permission to download & install Windows 11 for Free. Click on Accept and Install to proceed.

Step 4: Finish the Installation & Restart Your PC

The utility will now start the process automatically. Wait until the process is finished. After finishing, the utility will ask you to restart your PC to complete the installation of Windows 11. Click on Restart Now to proceed.

After rebooting, you will be able to operate on your newly installed Windows 11 PC.

2.2. Method 2: Create Windows 11 Installation Media

If you want to upgrade Windows 10 to Windows 11 using a bootable USB drive, creating Windows 11 Installation Media is a great method for tha. Let's see how you can perform this action:

Step 1: Visit the Official Microsoft Website

Go to Microsoft's Download Windows 11 page. Scroll down and you will find an an option there Create Windows 11 Installation Media.

Step 2: Click on the Download Now button to Start the Downloading Process

Click on the Download Now button located underneath Before you begin to start downloading the tool.

Step 3: Read and Accept Terms & License

Once the downloading gets completed, run the file and go through its terms and license. Click on Accept to proceed.

Step 4: Select the Language and Edition

Check the box that says Use the recommended options for this PC and hit Next.

Step 4: Choose the Media Type to Use

Click on the ISO file and hit Next.

Step 5: Choose What Data You Would Like to Keep

Hit the button that says Keep personal files only and click Next.

Step 6: Reboot Your PC once the Download Gets Completed

The downloading process will start automatically. After downloading, double-click on the setup file to begin installing. After finishing, reboot your PC to complete the installation of Windows 11.

2.3. Method 3: Download Windows 11 Disk Image (ISO)

If you'd rather use an ISO file to install Windows 11, below is the easy-to-go steps to perform this action:

Step 1: Step 1: Visit the Official Microsoft Website

Go to Microsoft's Download Windows 11 page. There you will see an option named Download Windows 11 Disk Image (ISO) for x64 devices.

Step 2: Choose the ISO file and Proceed to Download

Choose Windows 11 (multi-edition ISO for x64 devices) from the dropdown menu and click on Download to proceed.

Step 3: Click on Install button to Start the Process

After downloading, double-click on the setup file. The below screen will appear. Click on Install to start installing Windows 11.

Step 4: Reboot Your PC

After the installation is finished, reboot your computer. After booting up, you will able to operate on your newly installed Windows 11 PC.

3. Why Should You Upgrade to Windows 11?

Upgrading from Windows 10 to Windows 11 offers several benefits that enhances your overall in-hands experience. Here are a few key highlighters to support this upgradation:

  • Enhanced Performance: Windows 11 is designed for speed and accuracy and offers a fast boot time, better memory management, and enhanced performance which means it is suitable for handling multi tasks, playing high performance games, and much more.
  • Enriched User Interface: Windows 11 offers a whole new redefined user interface which is easy and user-friendly. Its feature such as the Start menu, redesigned Taskbar, and Snap Layouts helps in easy navigation.
  • Improved Gaming: Windows 11 comes with enhanced gaming features like DirectX 12 Ultimate, Auto HDR, and DirectStorage, providing a better gaming experience on compatible hardware.
  • Enhanced Virtual Desktop: Organize your workspace better with Virtual Desktops. With Windows 11, you can create multiple desktops for separate tasks and switch over them within a few clicks.
  • Personalization/Widgets: With Windows 11, you can explore exciting new widgets for Windows 11 that can provide you access to a quick overview of News Feed, Weather Update, and much more.
